About Stella

Baked with
Passion & Precision

Hi, I'm Stella Kanyi — a self-taught cake artist based in Nairobi. Every cake I make is built from scratch, decorated by hand, and designed to make your celebration unforgettable.

Fully Handcrafted

No shortcuts. Every tier, layer, and decoration is made by hand with quality ingredients.

Custom Designs

Your vision, your colours, your theme. We bring your dream cake to life.

Nairobi Delivery

We deliver fresh to your door across Nairobi. Orders ready in 48 hours.
